name: qa-dataviz
title_zh: 测试报告里的每个数字都得先过数据这道关
tagline_zh: 画测试趋势、缺陷流、覆盖率图时，它逼你每句结论都挂上原始数据，还顺手拦下双轴误导、截断坐标这类老毛病。
tagline_en: For test trends, defect flow, coverage plots: it forces each caption to cite raw rows, and blocks misleading.
desc_en: Build, prompt for, verify and review QA data visualizations (test runs, defects, coverage) with D3. Use when asked to chart test results, flakiness, durations, coverage or defect flow, to analyze a QA data file and report findings, to write a prompt that turns a data file into a report, or to critique a chart or the text around it. Enforces anti-pattern rules and data-grounded claims; carries the
why_zh: 不是画图工具，是带质检员的画图工具：先验数据再出图，图表和文字必须能回溯到行级记录，否则当场指出。
why_en: It's a chart tool with a built-in auditor: validates data before rendering, and every visual or textual claim must link to a.
limit_zh: 只认 QA 领域数据（测试运行、缺陷、覆盖率）；不接非测试类图表。产物是图表加校验过的结论，不生成完整测试报告。
limit_en: QA data only (test runs, defects, coverage). No general charting. Outputs validated charts + claims, not full reports. Needs local D3 runtime.
title_en: QA charts where every claim must trace back to the data
